text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the Spring Fan Fest. Everyone attending is enjoying the various events being held.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Whoa! There's so many people. Oh, if it isn't Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Vodka?! Did you come to watch the Tiara tour talk show as well?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: The Tiara tour talk show?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: …I guess not. Sigh… It's about to start, so shut up and watch if you're going to stay. I'm taking this seriously, so don't disturb me.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Wha—?! Then you make sure not to bother me either!

text_block_list.name: Girl with Braids
text_block_list.text: This way, this way! We'll be able to see her talk from over here!

text_block_list.name: Chestnut-haired Umamusume's Fan
text_block_list.text: …Tch. Why is she always at the same events?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Everyone, we'd like to express our dearest thanks to you all for coming to see our talk show today.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Your support meant so much to me last year. As a princess, I—

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Yeah, Princess did amazing last year! Although she's not as refined as her name might imply.

text_block_list.name: Chestnut-haired Umamusume's Fan
text_block_list.text: Sigh… There she goes babbling about princesses again. That's quite an ego—does she want to hog the spotlight for herself?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: The word "princess" brings to mind many different qualities. There's beauty, nobility, candor, and so much more.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: So when each of us say "princess," I think we all have different things in mind. And that's okay. They shouldn't be the same.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Certainly, these differences may sometimes lead us to hurt one another…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: But even so, I want to become the princess I envision for myself.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I have a lot of regrets, but also a lot to be proud of. That's why…

text_block_list.name: Girl with Braids
text_block_list.text: …Kawakami Princess?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I…

text_block_list.name: Suntanned Boy
text_block_list.text: Don't cry!

text_block_list.name: Suntanned Boy
text_block_list.text: To me, you're the coolest princess there is! I want to become a princess like you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A commotion begins to stir within the audience. The crowd separates, forming a circle around a young boy… and a woman.

text_block_list.name: Lady in a Dress
text_block_list.text: Ken?! Don't tell me you still harbor that foolish desire to become a princess…

text_block_list.name: Suntanned Boy
text_block_list.text: Mother… I know you told me it was impossible and that I should give up the thought…

text_block_list.name: Suntanned Boy
text_block_list.text: But I can't change how I feel! I want to be a princess!

text_block_list.name: Suntanned Boy
text_block_list.text: I want to be just like Kawakami Princess! A cool, strong, dazzling princess!

text_block_list.name: Lady in a Dress
text_block_list.text: At the very least, surely you should aim to be a prince instead! I mean, you're a…
choice_data_list: What do you say to that, Kawakami Princess? Is that true?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: No, it isn't! Whether or not he can become a princess all depends on his mindset and effort!

text_block_list.name: Lady in a Dress
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I believe that a princess is someone who never gives up. And how one becomes that princess is different for everyone!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Just as my vision differs from yours, I'm sure the boy has his own idea of what being a princess entails.
choice_data_list: There's no right or wrong here.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Indeed. It's not our place to tell others what to believe. That's for them to decide. Instead, focus on who you want to be.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: That way, when you look back on your past, you'll feel proud.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Proud of the fact… that you did it all yourself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Suddenly, I hear the sound of footsteps approaching…

text_block_list.name: Chestnut-haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I… think that she's right.

text_block_list.name: Chestnut-haired Umamusume's Fan
text_block_list.text: Huh? Y-you're…

text_block_list.name: Chestnut-haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I won't pretend it doesn't bug me when she talks about princesses in events and interviews, but that's my problem, not hers. She's her own person, and so am I!

text_block_list.name: Chestnut-haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: To tell the truth, I think you're amazing! But I believe that my own dream is even more incredible.

text_block_list.name: Chestnut-haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: That's why I won't lose our next race! When we compete, let's see which of us has grown more!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: …Gladly. I'll take you head-on in any race!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Daaang… The older racers are so cool!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Talk about nerves. I feel like my whole body tensed up.
choice_data_list: But you stayed true to your ideal of a princess.
But you stayed true to your ideal of a princess.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: You're right, and I won't lose sight of it again.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I can't be ignorant of the hurt I may cause others, but I won't be afraid. I'll continue down the path I've chosen.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: In order to become the princess I aspire to be… I'll conduct myself in a manner I can be proud of.
choice_data_list: I'm sure you'll become a role model for others, too.
I'm sure you'll become a role model for others, too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just as Princess Fighter inspired Kawakami Princess, I'm sure she will go on to inspire others.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hehe… I hope you're right.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grrrowl…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: …Ack.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh, come on… Why now?! How's anyone supposed to take me seriously if my stomach growls like a lion?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though Kawakami Princess laments her growling stomach, I'm only too happy to take her around to the different food stalls to show my appreciation for her effort and growth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Suddenly, I hear the sound of footsteps approaching…

text_block_list.name: Girl with Braids
text_block_list.text: Kawakami Princess, you were so cool up there!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Awww, are you enjoying the festival? They even have a punching tournament over there, you know? ♪

text_block_list.name: Girl with Braids
text_block_list.text: Whoa, really?! …I mean, Ken, you talked to your mom, right?

text_block_list.name: Suntanned Boy
text_block_list.text: Shut uuup… Anyway, my mom already said sorry.

text_block_list.name: Suntanned Boy
text_block_list.text: She apologized to me and gave me a pat on the head. So…

text_block_list.name: Suntanned Boy
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Princess! Later!

text_block_list.name: Girl with Braids
text_block_list.text: Ah, wait! Ken!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: …Oh my.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I'm sure the two of them will become wonderful princesses one day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In that moment, I take a glance at Kawakami Princess and see the eyes of a wonderful, bona fide princess.
